name: add_php_lru_cache
description: Implements a fixed-capacity LRU cache class with get/put eviction semantics
prompts: Create src/LruCache.php defining namespace App and class LruCache with a constructor __construct(int $capacity), a method get(string $key) that returns the cached value if $key is present (marking it as most-recently-used) or null if absent, and a method put(string $key, $value): void that inserts or updates the value for $key (marking it most-recently-used) and, if inserting a NEW key pushes the cache size above capacity, evicts the LEAST recently used entry. Recency must be updated by BOTH get and put - accessing or updating a key must protect it from the next eviction. Assume capacity is always a positive integer.

test_setup_files.tests/LruCacheTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/LruCache.php';

final class LruCacheTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testBasicPutGet(): void
    {
        $cache = new \App\LruCache(2);
        $cache->put("a", 1);
        $cache->put("b", 2);
        $this->assertSame(1, $cache->get("a"));
        $this->assertSame(2, $cache->get("b"));
    }

    public function testMissingKeyReturnsNull(): void
    {
        $cache = new \App\LruCache(2);
        $this->assertNull($cache->get("nope"));
    }

    public function testEvictsLeastRecentlyUsedNotOldestInserted(): void
    {
        $cache = new \App\LruCache(2);
        $cache->put("a", 1);
        $cache->put("b", 2);
        // Access "a" so "b" becomes the least recently used.
        $cache->get("a");
        $cache->put("c", 3); // should evict "b", not "a"
        $this->assertSame(1, $cache->get("a"));
        $this->assertNull($cache->get("b"));
        $this->assertSame(3, $cache->get("c"));
    }

    public function testUpdatingExistingKeyRefreshesRecency(): void
    {
        $cache = new \App\LruCache(2);
        $cache->put("a", 1);
        $cache->put("b", 2);
        $cache->put("a", 10); // update marks "a" most-recently-used
        $cache->put("c", 3); // should evict "b"
        $this->assertSame(10, $cache->get("a"));
        $this->assertNull($cache->get("b"));
        $this->assertSame(3, $cache->get("c"));
    }

    public function testCapacityNeverExceeded(): void
    {
        $cache = new \App\LruCache(1);
        $cache->put("a", 1);
        $cache->put("b", 2);
        $this->assertNull($cache->get("a"));
        $this->assertSame(2, $cache->get("b"));
    }
}

reference_solution.src/LruCache.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class LruCache
{
    private int $capacity;
    private array $store = [];

    public function __construct(int $capacity)
    {
        $this->capacity = $capacity;
    }

    public function get(string $key)
    {
        if (!array_key_exists($key, $this->store)) {
            return null;
        }
        $value = $this->store[$key];
        unset($this->store[$key]);
        $this->store[$key] = $value; // move to most-recently-used (end)
        return $value;
    }

    public function put(string $key, $value): void
    {
        if (array_key_exists($key, $this->store)) {
            unset($this->store[$key]);
        }
        $this->store[$key] = $value;
        if (count($this->store) > $this->capacity) {
            $oldestKey = array_key_first($this->store);
            unset($this->store[$oldestKey]);
        }
    }
}

<?php
namespace App;

class LruCache
{
    private int $capacity;
    private array $store = [];

    public function __construct(int $capacity)
    {
        $this->capacity = $capacity;
    }

    public function get(string $key)
    {
        // BUG: does not refresh recency - this behaves like FIFO, not LRU.
        return $this->store[$key] ?? null;
    }

    public function put(string $key, $value): void
    {
        if (!array_key_exists($key, $this->store)) {
            if (count($this->store) >= $this->capacity) {
                $oldestKey = array_key_first($this->store);
                unset($this->store[$oldestKey]);
            }
        }
        $this->store[$key] = $value;
    }
}
